svg.title: Introducing Create-Prisma: Start a Prisma App With One Command
svg.desc: An ink terminal card running npm create prisma at latest, with a checklist of what the CLI generates: a Prisma schema, a seed file, prisma.config.ts, a dotenv file with DATABASE_URL, and the database scripts. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism cyan accent.

g.text: Templates for Next.js, Nuxt, Hono, and more.
